hook: Voya Financial proves raw income alone fails to build true financial security.

sections.voiceover: Voya Financial proves raw income alone fails to build true financial security.
b_roll: A close-up shot of a smartphone screen displaying a bank balance.

sections.voiceover: Voya Financial surveyed 4,097 employed Americans ages 25 to 64 in October 2026. What actually drives your financial success?
b_roll: A wide shot of office workers seated at modern desks.
A graphic showing survey documents being compiled.

sections.voiceover: Except Voya Financial reveals that higher salaries alone fail to secure your retirement.
b_roll: An animation showing a rising income chart flattening out.

sections.voiceover: Voya Financial workplace financial education builds stronger habits for 4,097 surveyed workers. Voya Financial published 4,097 survey responses in October 2026.
b_roll: An instructor pointing to a financial growth chart on a whiteboard.
Employees smiling while reviewing retirement documents together.

sections.voiceover: Read America's Financial Confidence Index by Voya Financial to see how 4,097 workers build habits.
b_roll: The official report cover displayed on a clean desk.
